page.title: Create New Quote
page.heading: Create New Quote
page.caption: Follow the steps below to create a new quote

step1.title: Select Client & Award
step1.subtitle: Complete the details below to configure your quote
step1.wicRateNote: Client WIC Rate as of {date} is {rate}%

step2.title: Select Jobs
step2.subtitle: Building and Construction General On-site Award 2020
step2.tipMessage: Select the jobs and roles that apply to this quote. You can filter by job type or search for specific positions.
step2.autoIncreaseTooltip: Auto-increase non-base items when base rate changes

step3.title: Select Quote Items
instructions: Uncheck the box to remove items
Don't worry - you can add & edit items and titles on the next screen
step3.autoIncreaseNote: If switched on, increasing hourly (or base) pay rate automatically increase non base items pay rates
step3.baseRateLabel: Calculate increase from Perm / Base Rate
step3.baseRateNote: Hit enter key to re-calculate casual rates
